ecom.product_description: Meet your skin's new main character! Say goodbye to heavy, sticky creams that ruin your vibe. Our Watermelon Sunscreen SPF 50+ PA++++ is here to make daily sun defense super juicy and fun. Packed with fresh watermelon goodness, this ultra-light formula absorbs instantly with zero white cast and a non-oily finish that feels like nothing at all. Whether you are running to college or catching the metro, it layers like a dream under your makeup without any pilling or eye sting. Get reliable, skin-smart tan protection that stays fresh all day long, all for just ₹387. Your oily skin will thank you!

llm.score_rationale: The current listing copy is extremely sparse, covering only basic greasy/sticky aspects while completely omitting major customer-loved attributes like lightweight texture, non-greasy non-oily finish, lack of white cast, and absence of eye irritation or breakouts. The rewritten description incorporates these positive customer sentiments along with all factual specifications (SPF 50 PA++++, watermelon ingredients) and addresses common category concerns honestly.
